description: Prove an integration works: read the recording of a session the app published into, and check each expected participant actually carried media on each expected track. Returns whether each expected participant’s tracks hold media, plus, on failure, what is missing and what usually causes it. (Requires scope mcp:read.)

kinds.description: Tracks each participant must have (default cam and mic).

user_ids.description: Participants that must each have published.

name: verify_session
title: Verify session media
